breakdown.description: Calls the reflection first order but also instructs the solver to use n = 2 in Bragg's law; first-order diffraction requires n = 1.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification explicitly applies n = 2 in Bragg's law ('Apply Bragg's law with n = 2: 2λ = 2d sinθ'), directly repeating the error from the incomplete prompt. The ground truth specifies first-order reflection, which requires n = 1. The agent did not correct this inconsistency and arrived at 2θ ≈ 28.8° instead of the correct first-order result (≈ 14.3°).
